name: Example: notify with patient retries
description: Counts yesterday's searches that were cancelled or failed. If the job fails, an email is sent; when sending fails (a mail server that is down for a while), the action retries 5 times, waiting 2 minutes first and doubling each time, instead of the default 3 tries from 30 seconds.

steps.name: Failed and cancelled searches
steps.spl:
index=_audit action=search (info=failed OR info=canceled)
| stats count BY user, info
